value.body: A pharma distribution executive keeps medicines moving from manufacturers to pharmacies and hospitals. Pharma wholesalers, distributors, carrying-and-forwarding (C&F) agents and e-pharmacy warehouses hire them. Work includes processing orders, tracking batches and expiry dates, keeping storage conditions right and maintaining the records a drug licence requires.

items.label: Why the qualification matters
items.value: A drug wholesale licence needs a qualified 'competent person', often a registered pharmacist

items.label: Domestic pharma market turnover
items.note: Moving annual total, April 2024 to March 2025

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join a local wholesaler, distributor or pharmacy warehouse as an inventory or billing executive. Registration as a pharmacist allows them to act as the licence's competent person.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: warehouse in-charge, branch manager, or starting an own distributorship.
Experience here is useful background for opening a pharmacy or wholesale business.
Inspections by drug control authorities make accurate records essential.
